Tunnel Of Love Express I
Label (Cat #): CBS / Sony Records (15EP 8009)
Format: MiniCD
Country: Japan
Release date (Original year): 1988 (1988)
I have 2 copies
01- TOUGHER THAN THE REST
02- TOUGHER THAN THE REST [Live]
03- BE TRUE [Live]
